title: Sinulog 2027 float sponsorship rises to P800K amid cost pressures

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Sinulog 2027 organizers have raised the minimum float sponsorship package by P50,000 amid rising production costs. Sinulog Foundation Inc. (SFI) Executive Director Elmer “Jojo” Labella said the minimum float sponsorship package increased from P750,000 during the previous celebration to P800,000 for Sinulog 2027. The higher package also aims to regulate participation while maintaining the faster parade flow achieved during Sinulog 2026, which drew an estimated 5.2 million people, Labella said. “Medyo nitaas na ang atong lowest sa sponsorship package (The lowest sponsorship package has increased somewhat),” Labella said.
